## What changes?

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and rationale. Link the related issue (use Closes # only when resolved).

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Identify skipped checks, failures and remaining limits; distinguish fixture, live engine/provider, desktop and installer evidence.

## Compatibility and records

- [ ] Compatibility/migration effects are described, or no migration is required.
- [ ] A pending work record covers every meaningful change and exact affected path.
- [ ] Generated changelog is current and coverage was checked against the branch base.
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated and shared logs/images contain no credentials or private data.
